text.p: Eurobond primary market activity was almost at a standstill on Friday and the quiet holiday mood was expected to continue next week.
"It is likely to be very quiet next week -- we have absolutely nothing in the pipeline," a syndicate head at a U.S. bank said.
A handful of emerging market deals were scheduled to surface, but most borrowers would wait until after August, dealers said.
U.S. economic data released on Friday reaffirmed the growing belief that the U.S. has entered a new era of steady growth and low inflation.
The U.S. created 316,000 new non-farm jobs in July but average earnings were unchanged.
